propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket schemas omit write parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref) already supported by the library and CLI, rendering those operations unreachable over MCP.

FastMCP derives JSON schemas and input validation from handwritten callable signatures in _mcp_writes.py; undeclared payload keys are discarded before the adapter runs, even if the underlying library supports them.

The MCP adapter delegate calls forward only close_class for transition and assignee for claim, so parameter additions to signatures alone do not reach the library without corresponding changes to adapter forwarding logic.

MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket must expose and forward force, caused_by, ref, and reason parameters unchanged to rebar.transition and rebar.claim to achieve full parity with the CLI and library interfaces.
